unknown_path_policy.rule: A production mutation is unsupported unless its actor, target resource, lock or transaction boundary, and rollback surface are present in this registry. Callers must reject an unknown path before it writes.
unknown_path_policy.enforcement_status: This inventory is authoritative. Runtime lease enforcement is live at the fleet-config installer, mini release cut, and state DB lifecycle operator. The production tool dispatcher resolves write_file/patch targets before mutation. Only the intended macOS Hermes Mini context (/Users/colingreig/.hermes) activates the OS filesystem sandbox denying runtime-current, releases, and governed scripts unless the cutter session holds the matching lease; that context fails closed when sandbox-exec is unavailable, while unsupported platforms and other Hermes homes preserve normal terminal behavior. The regex shell hook is defense-in-depth only and is marked mandatory/fail-closed. Fleet-health-digest is a deterministic no-agent cron script executed under its exact hash-pinned release interpreter; it has no agent toolsets or delegation surface and emits delivery truth only in cron output. The five-minute verifier uses Apple Python only for a governed stdlib selector, which deterministically chooses a release-absolute interpreter with PyYAML from non-symlinked immutable release directories without consulting runtime-current or an environment-supplied path; selection failure is closed.

follow_on_hook_points.hook: production mutation admission check at governed installer and deploy entry points
follow_on_hook_points.purpose: Reject a requested resource mutation that has no registry actor/resource mapping.

actors.name: Fleet health digest cron

current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.kind: cron jobs advisory lock plus release-agnostic governed interpreter selector
current_lock_or_transaction_boundary.behavior: On every run the scheduler ignores runtime-current and environment hints, rejects symlinks at every releases/release/venv/bin/python provenance component, and selects the newest release-absolute interpreter that imports PyYAML and onepassword (falling back to an older retained release). The hash-manifested no-agent digest runs five read-only probe modes in memory and includes every non-clean result before permitting only fixed Postmark or Slack fallback delivery.

rollback_surface.surface: Digest delivery only
rollback_surface.procedure: No Hermes-owned production resource or receipt is changed by the digest; delivery correction is a subsequent digest or sender retry.

actors.notes: Email/fixed-channel delivery is the sole side effect. The no-agent script imports the deterministic report builder through its in-memory compose API, hash-verifies and executes the delivery, skill-size, model-deprecation, Supabase RLS, and usage checks in read-only probe mode under the selected interpreter, and folds every non-clean exit/output into the digest. It never creates a body artifact, check state, alert receipt, or duplicate check delivery. The fleet outcome probe verifies the digest's fresh cron output JSON (`status=sent` and a fixed channel). Recipient, fallback target, and body-file inputs remain unavailable.
